name: IKS Far Horizon
_comment: R3.43, Module R3 SSD book page 8. Corner YS:137 DK:7 EX:17 CR:8; annex gives crew 40 and 16
boarding parties, and the point value 140/120 is the economic/combat split (R3.R51), so
bpv 120.
A D7 hull refitted for exploration, and the trade is the whole character of the ship:
- NO APR AT ALL. The D7 carries four; this sheet's hull block runs IMP, TRAC, LAB, SHTTL,
IMP, DRN and there is no APR box anywhere on it. Owner, 2026-10-11: 'The D7E is an
exploration vessel. The 4 APR were replaced with 4 more labs.' Hence labs 8 — four in the
boom as the D7 has, and four more in the hull where the reactors were.
- two SPECIAL SENSORS (G24), drawn in the phaser colour, which is what the sheet's note
means: 'SPECIAL SENSORS ARE DESTROYED ON PHASER DAMAGE POINTS.' The D6E's are torpedo
points instead, and the dacHitLocation below is the field that says so.
- one drone rack rather than the D7's two, and seven phaser-2s rather than nine: the
D7's wing pair goes, leaving three forward and two on each side, which is exactly the
layout our D6S scout already uses.
- four cargo boxes and a third shuttle box.
The SCOUT FUNCTIONS SUMMARY printed on the sheet lists G24.21 to G24.29. Five of those nine
are implemented; the channels themselves are what this file declares.
WORTH CHECKING when this is reviewed: security reads 3 here (one boom box, two in the hull)
where the plain D7 has 2, and probes read 2 where the D7 has 1. Both are plausible for a
survey ship and both were counted off the sheet rather than inherited.
_refitComment: Three costs off the ship data table: UIM REFIT (Y165) +5, B REFIT (Y165) +4, Y175 REFIT +1.
The sheet adds 'DERFACS INSTALLED AS PART OF THE B REFIT IN Y165' and 'SHADED BOXES ARE ADDED
BY THE B REFIT', and the rack note: type-F with one reload, type-A at the B refit, type-B with
two reloads at Y175. Unlike the D6E there is no disruptor-range note, so these are range 30
throughout, as the plain D7's are.
